mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for master bathrooms right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: Current popular design trends for master bathrooms include incorporating natural elements, smart technology, and spa-like features. Freestanding tubs, large walk-in showers with multiple showerheads, and warm, neutral color palettes are highly sought after. Sustainable materials and improved lighting design, including ambient and task lighting, are also common requests. Hometelligent Inc. stays updated on these trends and can help integrate them into your design while ensuring functionality and timeless appeal for your Bay Area home.
